CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents was present.

COD.rationale: Content (red) and an organization/access attribute (origin) are both explicitly listed for the same referent/time; the report separates content listing and origin metadata.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement linked to the listed content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly enumerates content items (color-labeled coordinate sets) for multiple referents.

D.rationale: Content attributes (red) are listed separately from organization/access metadata (origin) for the same referent, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: The report states how specific referent contents are presented/derived using origin metadata, describing their organization/access.
